description: SWARM Read Page - The readable text of a web page, menus, scripts and markup removed (median 97% fewer tokens than the raw HTML). HTML or text up to 3 MB. Returns JSON: title, text, word count. Not billed if the page cannot be read. $0.002. Pays in USDC on Base via x402 when SWARM_WALLET_KEY is set (quote checked against SWARM_MAX_USD first; charged only on success). On failure it says whether you were charged and if a retry is safe; it never retries on its own.

url.description: Public http(s) URL, ports 80/443 only. Example: https://example.com

name: read_page
title: Read a web page
